magic_signatures.description: 8-byte ASCII save identifier 'n0230113' (block 0 of EEPROM image)

fields.name: save_id_magic
fields.description: 8-byte ASCII save identifier 'n0230113'. Written by FUN_08001088 (8-byte copy into save block 0) and byte-compared on load by FUN_080010f0; all-zero/blank saves are rejected.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001088 copies 8 bytes into the save staging buffer (_DAT_080010e4/_DAT_080010e8, lines 343-350) and persists them as EEPROM block 0 via FUN_08002578. FUN_080010f0 reads block 0 via FUN_080022fc and accepts the save only if all 8 bytes match the ROM reference (8-iteration compare loop, lines 411-421). Baseline bytes 0-7 decode to 'n0230113'.

fields.name: save_spare_u32_a
fields.description: First word of the zero-filled spare region (start of EEPROM block 1). The decomp exposes no reader or writer for this word; it is persisted verbatim by the block-write loop, so it serves as a typed mutation probe.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001088 clears the 128-byte save image via FUN_08004844 (line 340) and writes EEPROM blocks 1-15 from that cleared buffer with FUN_08002578 in a 0x10-iteration loop (lines 354-360); no function in decomp/decompiled.c.gz reads or stores these bytes. Baseline bytes 8-11 are 0x00000000.

fields.name: save_spare_u32_b
fields.description: Second word of the zero-filled spare region (end of EEPROM block 1). No decomp reader/writer; persisted verbatim by the block-write loop; typed mutation probe.
fields.evidence: Same write path as save_spare_u32_a: FUN_08001088 + FUN_08004844 clear, FUN_08002578 block loop (lines 354-360); no readers in decomp. Baseline bytes 12-15 are 0x00000000.

fields.name: save_spare_blocks_low
fields.description: Zero-filled spare bytes covering EEPROM blocks 2-7 (save offsets 16-63). Written as zeros, never read back by any decomp routine.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001088 writes 16 8-byte EEPROM blocks from the FUN_08004844-cleared buffer via FUN_08002578 (lines 354-360); only block 0 carries data (the 8-byte ID). FUN_080010f0 reads back only block 0 via FUN_080022fc. Baseline bytes 16-63 are all 0x00.

fields.name: save_spare_blocks_high
fields.description: Zero-filled spare bytes covering EEPROM blocks 8-15 (save offsets 64-127). Written as zeros, never read back by any decomp routine. Bytes 128-511 are unwritten 0xFF EEPROM fill.
fields.evidence: Same FUN_08001088 16-block write span (offsets 0-127); FUN_080010f0 never reads past block 0. Baseline bytes 64-127 are all 0x00 and bytes 128-511 are all 0xFF.
